changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 17 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000605).
